title: IVG Savr 3000 Blueberry Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods offer a mellow and juicy vape with soft, rounded Blueberry flavour throughout. It's a simple, satisfying fruit profile that's smooth on the draw and gently sweet on the finish. Each refill pack contains a 2ml pod and a 4ml refill reservoir prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid. Once connected, the refill system automatically feeds the pod with e-liquid as you vape — offering up to 3000 puffs with no manual refilling or coil changes. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
